visibleGains: Coherent curl volume and root-to-tip hierarchy replace the former wiry lower flare in complete front/oblique views.
Hairline coverage and side/perimeter silhouette improve in those views under both recorded lighting conditions.
regressions: Rear crown exposes a new scalp gap absent from the original publisher curly reference.
Coarse highlights and artificial/waxy face/skin response remain; the complete woman is not accepted.

function.editScope: One actual free-control edit with fixed cap/density/seed/output curve order, then exact in-memory restore. Structural edits require rebuilding bindings; no claim that all arbitrary edits preserve contact.

contact.scope: Strong interior native knots in the declared Catmull-Rom hair model; closed-body and exact visible-skin correspondence checked. No exact installed Cycles binary/interpolant certificate, no full self/root or continuous clearance. The large interior witnesses prevent adoption; no thickness shrink or hidden failed curves.

retainedResearch.purpose: Use the same complete woman with actual303 editable source guides, live generated hair, actual root metadata, original controls, scoped reversible guide operation and improved front/side hairstyle reference.
retainedResearch.scope: Unaccepted complete research. Rear coverage, body intersections, original frame target, full physics/contact and runtime remain failed or unaccepted.
retainedResearch.minimumIntegrationStep: Continue directly from the retained complete r81B curly study for targeted hair work, while keeping r76 as the registered accepted-scope body/oral working source and rollback. Do not rebuild or retune the old long hair. The original curly reference has full rear coverage, while guide-root-frame-only transplantation creates a new rear scalp gap and neutral free-shaft body interior witnesses up to13.638mm. Change the registration construction: keep the publisher303-guide curl program in its original source-head/cap space, and use one bounded complete-head deformation cage with explicit source/target head landmarks to transport the whole generated curl volume, rather than rotating only guide roots before procedural curling. Preserve live free-guide editing, source parting and the exact r76 body/face/oral controls; retain Brown hair and source radii/density without sweeps. First full head/body plus rear pilot must show restored posterior coverage and retained front/side volume; then cheap actual finite hair/body falsification. If that construction worsens silhouette or remains invalid, stop it, preserve the native-guide infrastructure and choose a different credible editable groom instead of generic output fields. A/B frame-target failures remain recorded; do not spend another round sweeping patch size or tightening floating-point checks instead of visible integration. Self/follicle/continuous and natural hair/cloth dynamics, complete character realism and actual Aevrynd runtime/LOD/performance remain mandatory. Do not claim rigid following is natural motion or adopt failed contacts.
